fact: ATOP reports that ZETES/SNEDAI is training data-entry operators on the software of biometric kits to enrol voters in the CENI's 2025 revision of the electoral lists, with 5,200 operators to be deployed.
A presidential decree of 1 April 2025 opened roll revision from 7 to 23 April 2025, in which the CENI revises the electoral file and issues biometric voter cards.
An OIF audit mission judged the biometric electoral register, with 4,432,936 voters counted after the 2023 census, reliable enough for the regional and legislative polls.
